witness_status.claim: Every populated language item requires one exact user-phrase grounding record.
Candidate inference remains review posture until explicit user confirmation.
Every unordered candidate-term pair is checked and collapsed or unresolved pairs block.
Normalized term and candidate-definition collisions block independently of agent-declared pair status.
Every applicable classification-axis pair is checked; redundant, unresolved, or unnamed coupling blocks.
A blocked quality result cannot reach scope confirmation or Definition Pack construction.
A passing quality evaluation and its source evidence are retained in the candidate Definition Pack.
Realistic grounding, non-collapse, and orthogonality defects each produce a focused user-facing repair question and cannot reach confirmation until corrected.
Eleven decision entries compile from canonical .alch through selected and source-linked ontology plus Craft DomainSpec v2 project artifacts; missing, stale, or non-repeatable stages fail closed.
Aggregate language readiness cannot pass without explicit user confirmation even when every dimension input reports pass.
The generated service exposes every declared entry exactly once and a clean rebuild is byte-identical.
Define consumes semantic-key and boundary-aware contains-phrase through the shared adapter over the generated Alch semantic-contract runtime rather than reimplementing them in host JavaScript.
Separator-equivalent phrases match while a substring inside a larger token cannot satisfy direct semantic grounding.

Grounding, non-collapse, and orthogonality evidence-posture meanings are compiled from Alch while the three inventoried hosts retain only mechanical collection, construction, interface, and orchestration work.

Define, Router, and ARE request intent bind the same compiled semantic runtime through their declared direct or Module Port integration; separator equivalence passes, substrings do not collapse into route commands, and each consumer retains separate policy and authority.

The existing Alch Constitution reference is bound to an exact capability-local candidate with compatibility, fail-closed degraded behavior, conformance evidence, and an unselected owner request; hostile silent fallback and implicit adoption block while governed conformance remains not evaluable.

ARE request intent and its Codex composition root load with an empty Module Port; lexical inference is unavailable rather than false, while explicit caller-supplied objective evidence remains usable and no fallback executes.

A realistic handoff-ready reviewed Definition Pack deterministically projects into Alch source and passes through semantic-contract ontology, Craft DomainSpec compilation, runtime projection, fixtures, and a digest-bound no-authority receipt; missing quality, independent defects, open meaning, and overwrite attempts block.

claim_ceiling: Exact local deterministic coverage and contradiction checks over agent-proposed, user-reviewed evidence only; no proof of semantic truth, canonical status, conformance, admission, publication, release, deployment, or downstream authority.
